objective.title: Qualify and close M7 advanced research work package

declared.summary: Close M7-W01 as a verified research-only advanced-model portfolio after its five accepted phases, ten tasks and thirty Q/O/D subtasks completed. Reconcile ten historical source-pinned receipts and independent precision, tensor, DAG and PlotModel scalar oracles; preserve four explicit provider/API deferrals. Keep M7-W02 and release M7 open; deliver no advanced public package.
declared.value: An independent BCL C# gate verifies exact historical source SHA-256 pins, all five native/product phase completions, 541 native nodes and bounded scientific witnesses: exact-vs-binary64 cancellation 1/0, tensor 36/6, diamond 13 and reciprocal 4 points/2 segments. Record one W01 research receipt with product/non-publication negative gates and owner-specific re-entry triggers.
debtChanges: All M7-W01 advanced phases are completed research decisions, not public arbitrary-precision, tensor, DAG or PlotModel product implementations.
Any future advanced API must satisfy its original three consumer/domain, bounded-resource/error and exact source/license/RID/source-free-owner gates.
Scientific fixtures have finite limits, not certified production memory/cancellation/performance or uncertainty guarantees.
AURA retains job agents, scheduler and rendering; no sibling integration, public package, new dw.discovery surface or provider cutover is authorized.
M7-W02 proof interoperability and review plus the M7 1.2.0-candidate milestone remain incomplete after W01 closure.
